notes: SwarmWorld Core launch manifest for Sepolia (chain id 11155111). This manifest describes the accepted tree only; it is not deployment authority and no contributor assignment broadcast a transaction or touched a wallet key. Token: LaunchToken in src/LaunchToken.sol, a fixed-supply ERC-20 named SwarmWorld with symbol SWARM and 18 decimals (all three are compile-time constants in the source). Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens (10^27 minor units, TOTAL_SUPPLY = 1_000_000_000 ether) once to msg.sender, which is the ProjectFactory at launch. It exposes only transfer, approve and transferFrom plus the standard views; there is no mint, burn, owner, pause, blocklist, fee, initializer or upgrade path, and the runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. Application contract: SwarmWorld in src/SwarmWorld.sol, listed as the single entry in contracts. Its constructor takes no arguments, so constructorArgs is empty by necessity rather than omission: the contract declares no owner, admin, token address, factory address or external dependency, and therefore no $owner, $token or $contract reference exists to fill. The constructor seeds the three settlements exactly as the brief specifies (0 Genesis City: energy 500, food 500, materials 500, knowledge 500, population 100, stability 80; 1 Iron Valley: 420, 550, 700, 350, population 100, stability 75; 2 Nova Port: 120, 420, 300, 180, population 100, stability 75) and records block.timestamp as lastTickAt so the first permissionless tick() becomes callable 24 hours after deployment. SwarmWorld never references LaunchToken. All value inside SwarmWorld is native ETH escrowed per mission through the payable openEnergyMission(); worker rewards (builder 50%, tester 15%, reviewer 15%, verifier the remainder including rounding dust) and sponsor refunds for FAILED or EXPIRED missions are credited to claimable balances and withdrawn through claim(), which zeroes the balance before sending. The contract has no receive or fallback function, so ETH can only enter through openEnergyMission(). Seat IDs are stored for provenance only and are not authenticated by the contract. Pool: paired against native ETH (zero address), fee 3000, tickSpacing 60, no hook. initialPrice is the sqrtPriceX96 for a 1:1 opening (2^96) and is consulted only by legacy policies; the pinned Sepolia policy derives the effective opening price from its initialMarketCapWei. The factory seeds liquidity with the launch token only. With one application contract the dependency order is trivial, and no contract other than LaunchToken and SwarmWorld exists in src/.
